properties.name: spring.feign.client.config.*.call-timeout
properties.description: The longest one call may take **in all**: every attempt, the pauses of the `Retryer` and the wait for the answer. Default: none (`0` or less: none).

properties.name: spring.feign.client.config.*.connect-timeout
properties.description: **Under `default` only**: the connect timeout of the transport all clients share. Default: `10s` (`0`: none).

properties.name: spring.feign.client.config.*.default-query-parameters.*
properties.description: The same for query parameters. The URL with its query is in the log lines and in exception messages, so prefer a header for a secret.

properties.name: spring.feign.client.config.*.default-request-headers.*
properties.description: Headers sent when the request has none of that name; `default`'s and the client's are merged, the client's winning for the same name. A comma list or an indexed list gives several values.

properties.name: spring.feign.client.config.*.dismiss404
properties.description: A 404 gives `null` (or a `ResponseEntity`) instead of an exception; `void` methods still throw. Default: `false`.

properties.name: spring.feign.client.config.*.error-decoder
properties.description: The client's `ErrorDecoder`: a bean name, or a class name matching the type of exactly one bean. Default: `DefaultErrorDecoder`.

properties.name: spring.feign.client.config.*.event-stream.max-attempts
properties.description: How many connections in a row may end without an event before the stream gives up. Default: no limit.

properties.name: spring.feign.client.config.*.event-stream.reconnect
properties.description: An `EventStream<T>` method connects again when the connection ends. Default: `true`.

properties.name: spring.feign.client.config.*.event-stream.reconnect-delay
properties.description: The wait before connecting again. Default: `3s`, or the server's `retry:`.

properties.name: spring.feign.client.config.*.follow-redirects
properties.description: Follows redirects; with `false` a 3xx answer is an error. Default: `true`.

properties.name: spring.feign.client.config.*.logger-level
properties.description: How much of each call is logged, under the logger `feign.<Interface>` at debug level. Default: `none`.

properties.name: spring.feign.client.config.*.read-timeout
properties.description: The longest wait for the response, then between two chunks of the body; not a limit for the whole call. Default: `60s` (`0`: none).

properties.name: spring.feign.client.config.*.request-interceptors
properties.description: More `RequestInterceptor` beans, by bean name or class name: `default`'s, then the client's, after those the client has anyway.

properties.name: spring.feign.client.config.*.retryer
properties.description: The client's `Retryer`: a bean name, or a class name matching the type of exactly one bean. Default: never retries.

properties.name: spring.feign.client.config.*.sensitive-headers
properties.description: More headers whose values the `headers` and `full` logs show as `***` (names in any case): `default`'s, then the client's. `Authorization`, `Proxy-Authorization`, `Cookie`, `Set-Cookie` and `DPoP` always are.

properties.name: spring.feign.client.config.*.url
properties.description: The base URL when `@FeignClient(url:)` is empty; `http://` is added when the scheme is missing. `${...}` placeholders are allowed.

properties.name: spring.feign.client.decode-slash
properties.description: `false` encodes `/` in path variables as `%2F`. One setting for all clients.

values.description: Nothing; the default. Failed connections and retries are not logged either.
The method and URL of each request, the status and the time of each response, failed connections and retries.

[basic] plus the headers of requests and responses, with the values of credentials shown as `***`: `Authorization`, `Proxy-Authorization`, `Cookie`, `Set-Cookie`, `DPoP` (a proof of possession) and those of the `sensitive-headers` property ([FeignClientConfig.sensitiveHeaders]).
